entries.heading: TAXPAYER ELIGIBLE FOR CHILDLESS EARNED INCOME CREDIT IN CASE OF QUALIFYING CHILDREN WHO FAIL TO MEET CERTAIN IDENTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
entries.text:
SEC. 9622. TAXPAYER ELIGIBLE FOR CHILDLESS EARNED INCOME CREDIT IN 
                          CASE OF QUALIFYING CHILDREN WHO FAIL TO 
                          MEET CERTAIN IDENTIFICATION 
                          REQUIREMENTS.

    (a) In General.--Section 32(c)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 
1986 is amended by striking subparagraph (F).

    (b) Effective Date.--The amendment made 
by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 
31, 2020.
